parsed_json.up: Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id aliased as molecule_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name aliased as molecule_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4813957'. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending. Return all rows.
